description: Golden reference for PEEC+BEM 1-way on the coarse BEM sample.
rationale: Knowledge accumulation mechanism: locks in the known-good P output of calc_peec_bem.py against the 2D axisym full-eddy reference, so regressions in _extract_bnd_only (normal winding, FD filtering) fail loudly on CI and not during user validation.

physics.coil: gapped torus R=30mm a=3mm gap=5deg, Cu sigma=5.8e7
physics.workpiece: cylinder R=25mm H=25mm, Cu sigma=5.8e7, mu_r=1

reference_2d_axisym_full_eddy.note: Geometry has no gap; the 3D gap=5deg gives ~1.4% asymmetry. The 2D reference P INCLUDES coil ohmic + wp skin.  The BEM 1-way value below is wp skin only and matches the 2D SIBC (sigma_coil=0) case which is also ~6.6e-5.

reference_2d_axisym_sibc.note: wp SIBC only (sigma_coil=0); comparable to BEM P_wp 1-way output.
